name: Special Commission for the Arts Meeting
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Commission for the Arts Meeting
AGENDA
MAY 18, 2026 -
11:30 AM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
INTRODUCTION OF ARTS PROGRAM MANAGER – LAURETTE GARNER
5.
COMMUNITY WORKSHOP: ENCINITAS COMMUNITY PARK MURAL
A.
Welcome + Framing (15 minutes)
1.
Mural Donation Offer from Encinitas Friends of the Arts
2.
Poods Mural background and process
3.
Purpose and framing of the meeting
4.
Introduction to the Poods site and intended location of mural
i.
Encinitas Public Art Policy (Attachment 1)
i. Encinitas Public Art Policy (Attachment 1)
ii.
Encinitas Public Visual Art Policy (Attachment 2)
ii. Encinitas Public Visual Art Policy (Attachment 2)
B.
Small Group Brainstorm – Round 1 (25 minutes) “Authenticity & Skate Culture”
1.
Prompts:
a.
Have you seen artwork or murals at skate parks that really work? What makes them successful? Have you seen ones that didn’t work? Why?
b.
What makes art feel authentic to skate culture versus something that feels forced or out of place?
C.
Large Group Share – Round 1 (15 minutes)
1.
1 person from each small group reads feedback
2.
Brief group discussion: “What do you notice? What’s missing?”
3.
Commissioner records main take-aways
D.
Small Group Brainstorm – Round 2 “Poods, Encinitas & Place” (25 min)
1.
Prompts:
a.
Should a mural at Poods reflect something about Encinitas or the skate park itself? If yes, what kinds of things?
b.
If someone filmed a skate clip at this park and posted it, what would you want people to notice in the background?
c.
What would make a mural feel like it truly belongs at this skate park?
E.
Large Group Share – Round 2 (15 minutes)
1.
1 person from each small group reads feedback
2.
Brief group discussion: “What do you notice? What’s missing?”
3.
Commissioner records main take-aways
F.
Break (5 minutes)
1.
During break: Visitors are invited to fill out a Fill-in Prompt
2.
“A mural at Poods should be ________, ________, and ________.”
G.
Closing Large Group Discussion (10 min)
1.
Some of the Fill-in prompts will be shared
2.
Brief group discussion: “Any comments? Anything to add?”
3.
Final question “Is there anything else you think the city should understand about skate culture for this process?”
4.
Commissioner shares what will happen with the input
5.
Commission asks groups to fill out Workshop evaluations
ADJOURNMENT
